concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-dispute-find-node]] - Braintree Node.js single-dispute lookup by dispute ID, restricted to merchants with Control Panel dispute access and preserving the results-limitation policy notice
warnings: Retain the PayPal Data Protection Addendum notice without interpreting the unread external policy or specifying which results or fields are limited.
Keep API availability qualified to merchants who can access disputes in the Braintree Control Panel.
Keep this source scoped to one-dispute lookup by ID; do not generalize it to dispute search, acceptance, evidence submission, or finalization.
Treat the linked Dispute response page as navigation only; this source does not establish its unread response fields, status schema, or missing-ID behavior.
